summary: Sitaxentan was pulled from the market worldwide starting in 2010 due to liver harm [3]. In a small computer model rather than tests on people, the drug received a high risk score of 79 for liver issues and a low risk score of 30 for heart issues [M]. Furthermore, clinical research trials were ended early on December 9, 2010, because of safety concerns regarding emerging evidence of hepatic injury, which means liver damage [5][6][7].
